paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Challah, chapter 2, halakhah 3: “The students of Rabbi Chiyya the Great. Bar Lulita reported in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied fragment begins with the plural “students of Rabbi Chiyya the Great,” then names Bar Lulita reporting in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Guggenheimer at Jerusalem Talmud Challah 2:3 preserves this sequence; the fragment does not separately explain the plural.

The whole Guggenheimer Challah 2:3 paragraph has the plural students of Rabbi Chiyya the Great, then Bar Lulita in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Those local full titles and the sequence are supported. The supplied plural fragment and existing note remain, without a unique-student identification or new teacher relationship.
